name: personalized-tourist-guide-ai
description: Professional AI-assisted travel planning application with personalised itineraries, maps and saved routes.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run security:scan && npm run release:audit
